errors.evidence: The description overestimates the y-values for x=1 and x=4. The y-value at x=1 is closer to 83.3 than 83.4. The y-value at x=4 is significantly overestimated as 83.3; it is only slightly above the value at x=3 (83.2), making it closer to 83.25.
The description fails to mention the chart's title, '3个数据集平均值' (Average value of 3 datasets), which is a critical part of the chart's overall purpose.
